description.en:
Native stereoscopic VR with full 6DOF head tracking, on foot and in the cab. Mod for Farming Simulator. Unofficial - not affiliated with or endorsed by GIANTS Software.
Requires the fs25vr bridge (dinput8.dll + openxr_loader.dll in the game's x64 folder) and an OpenXR runtime (SteamVR, Oculus, WMR, Virtual Desktop...).
F6: projection centred / off-centre F7: ambient occlusion: game setting / force SAO F8: recentre the view F9: VR camera on/off F10: HUD on/off in VR (hidden by default) F11: VR settings (stereo mode, quad views, 3D resolution)
